functions.documentation: Constructs one exact signal-processing window with explicit dtype, device, and pin-memory controls.
functions.name: window_native
functions.terlan_body: let selected_dtype = window_dtype(dtype); let selected_device = window_device(device_type, device_index); if { operation == 0 -> window_bartlett(window_length, periodic, selected_dtype, Strided, selected_device, pin_memory); operation == 1 -> window_blackman(window_length, periodic, selected_dtype, Strided, selected_device, pin_memory); operation == 2 -> window_hamming(window_length, periodic, alpha, beta, selected_dtype, Strided, selected_device, pin_memory); operation == 3 -> window_hann(window_length, periodic, selected_dtype, Strided, selected_device, pin_memory); operation == 4 -> window_kaiser(window_length, periodic, beta, selected_dtype, Strided, selected_device, pin_memory); true -> let _failed = std.vm.Process.fail(std.vm.Process.exit_reason(7250)); window_bartlett(window_length, periodic, selected_dtype, Strided, selected_device, pin_memory) }

functions.documentation: Writes one exact signal-processing window into retained output storage.
functions.name: window_out_native
functions.terlan_body: if { operation == 0 -> window_bartlett_out(output, window_length, periodic); operation == 1 -> window_blackman_out(output, window_length, periodic); operation == 2 -> window_hamming_out(output, window_length, periodic, alpha, beta); operation == 3 -> window_hann_out(output, window_length, periodic); operation == 4 -> window_kaiser_out(output, window_length, periodic, beta); true -> std.vm.Process.fail(std.vm.Process.exit_reason(7250)) }

functions.documentation: Maps the stable package dtype selector to the generated CXX dtype atom.

functions.terlan_body: if { code == 0 -> UInt8; code == 1 -> Int8; code == 2 -> Int16; code == 3 -> Int32; code == 4 -> Int64; code == 5 -> Float16; code == 6 -> Float32; code == 7 -> Float64; code == 8 -> Complex32; code == 9 -> Complex64; code == 10 -> Complex128; code == 11 -> Bool; code == 12 -> QInt8; code == 13 -> QUInt8; code == 14 -> QInt32; code == 15 -> BFloat16; code == 16 -> QUInt4x2; code == 17 -> QUInt2x4; code == 18 -> Bits1x8; code == 19 -> Bits2x4; code == 20 -> Bits4x2; code == 21 -> Bits8; code == 22 -> Bits16; code == 23 -> Float8E5M2; code == 24 -> Float8E4M3Fn; code == 25 -> Float8E5M2Fnuz; code == 26 -> Float8E4M3Fnuz; code == 27 -> UInt16; code == 28 -> UInt32; code == 29 -> UInt64; code == 30 -> UInt1; code == 31 -> UInt2; code == 32 -> UInt3; code == 33 -> UInt4; code == 34 -> UInt5; code == 35 -> UInt6; code == 36 -> UInt7; code == 37 -> Int1; code == 38 -> Int2; code == 39 -> Int3; code == 40 -> Int4; code == 41 -> Int5; code == 42 -> Int6; code == 43 -> Int7; code == 44 -> Float8E8M0Fnu; code == 45 -> Float4E2M1FnX2; true -> let _failed = std.vm.Process.fail(std.vm.Process.exit_reason(7250)); Float32 }
